name: codex-tags
description: Add tag-aware session browsing and local content search to the Codex desktop sidebar.

interface.shortDescription: Tag, filter, and search local Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Codex Tags installs a reversible local enhancement for the official Codex desktop app. It renders structured session tags, supports custom colors and optional AI classification descriptions, provides a searchable Tags dashboard, and keeps session content on the local machine.
defaultPrompt: Use $doctor to check whether Codex Tags is healthy.
Use $initial to tag my active Codex sessions using my configured tags.
Use $rename to name this session with the best matching configured tag.
